analysis.reference_method: Single-cluster Wolff updates on an L=16 periodic square lattice (H = -J sum s_i s_j, J = k_B = 1, bond probability 1 - exp(-2/T)). Equilibration: cold (all +1) and hot (random) starts evolved in parallel until cold |m| <= hot |m| at step t*, then 4t* further clusters. Measurement: |m| recorded after every cluster flip; runs start at 1000 clusters per T and are doubled as needed until the jackknife error on U is below 0.0005 at 40, 50 and 60 blocks. U = 1 - <m^4>/(3<m^2>^2), errors by blocked jackknife over 50 contiguous blocks. Seeds are triples: [137,int(10*T),0] (cold start), [137,int(10*T),1] (hot start).
